purpose: Reproduce the closest artifact's deterministic recovery controls on its author-selected replication subset, then isolate which conclusion changes when nonterminal and stale-negative schedules are added.

source.title: Did It Happen? Benchmarking LLM Agents on Ambiguous Tool Outcomes in Software Engineering
source.creator: Shengyao Sun

slice_selection.rule: Use all six template ids selected by the source authors in frozen_manifest_sqj_v1_4.json:replication_subset_ids; do not substitute tasks after observing results.

post_freeze_correction.original_incorrect_check: The first frozen draft expected aggregate prompt_only_stop_exact_state_rate=0.5.
post_freeze_correction.observed_source_behavior: The upstream reserve_then_link simulator requires the downstream link, so stopping after an executed-but-response-lost reservation is not exact-state success. Aggregate stop is therefore 4/12, not 6/12.
post_freeze_correction.corrected_check: Use the upstream artifact's own pre-existing gate: max(stop, retry)=0.5 separately in every structural family. Preserve and report both raw stop and retry rates.
post_freeze_correction.scope: This corrects a deterministic source-control transcription error. It does not change the author-selected slice, extension schedules, policies, primary estimand, outcomes, or interpretation rule.

retrybench_extension_block.negative_status_contract: A negative lookup reports only that no completed effect is currently visible. It does not prove terminal non-execution and may be stale.
retrybench_extension_block.terminal_status_contract: Status distinguishes terminal non-execution, committed execution, and nonterminal in-flight execution; the recovery policy waits for in-flight work and retries only terminal non-execution.
retrybench_extension_block.settlement_rule: Every in-flight original operation settles before exact-state scoring.
retrybench_extension_block.primary_estimand: Equal-template exact-state success-rate change for status reconciliation when a negative observation is incorrectly treated as retry permission over the four-world extension, compared with authoritative status reconciliation over the source two-world design.
retrybench_extension_block.invariant_check: Stable idempotency must remain exactly-once safe in every template and schedule.
retrybench_extension_block.interpretation_rule: If authoritative source status and stable idempotency reproduce at 100%, but weak-negative retry loses exact-state safety only in the added schedules, conclude that the source status benefit is conditional on evidence authority/terminality; do not claim the source result is false.

execution.source_code_execution: Run the source artifact's own TaskFamilySimulator and run_family_episode for the source-faithful block after commit and file-hash validation.
